description: A page of the conversation with one message in its middle (ADR 0390): `around` is its record id, half of `limit` rows end at it and the rest follow, oldest first, past the history floor. `has_more` says older rows exist (page back with `before`) and `has_newer` newer ones (page on with `after`). A row he said inside a topic carries `topic` {id, name}. An id that names no message is a 404; `around` with `after` or `before` is a 400.
